title: CarbonPlan 2D tavg demo, v2 bucket prefix (ndpyramid)
description:
The `v2/demo/2d/tavg` sibling of carbonplan-2d-tavg: the same CarbonPlan ndpyramid shape under the older bucket prefix. 6 levels (`0` coarsest 128x128 .. `5` finest 4096x4096), each level a group holding `<level>/tavg` [y, x] float32 beside its own `x`, `y` and `spatial_ref` arrays. Chunk is 128x128 at every level, so the coarsest level is one chunk and the finest is 32 chunks across. Level and chunk shapes confirmed from `5/tavg/.zarray` and `0/tavg/.zarray`; CRS confirmed from `0/spatial_ref/.zattrs` (`crs_wkt`, EPSG:3857 with a PROJ4 extension). `multiscales` is the array spelling and carries nothing but a path and `pixels_per_tile` per level -- no transform, no shape, no CRS -- so the only description of the grid is in the levels' own coordinate arrays. CORS confirmed (`access-control-allow-origin: *`).

License is unclear for this GCS demo bucket; linked via the CarbonPlan maps project.

Expected browser outcome: draws (viridis ramp), at a world view -- the coarsest level is one chunk.

tavg.description: Finest level (path "5") is [4096, 4096]; level n is [128 * 2^n, 128 * 2^n]. Chunk is 128x128 at every level.
